w05.title: Strategy Memo – Week 5
w05.author: John (GM)
w05.modeWhy: 95.5% playoff odds. The #1 seed's bye lifts title odds from ~22% to ~36%, so we invest AND hunt the bye (#1 seed 44.9% after the trade). Points scored matter: they break multi-team ties.
w05.huddle: Revised Oct 8 for the Jones-for-Moore trade. Waiver order, Moore's team, Atlanta's kickoff and Jacobs' status per live ESPN, Oct 8.

items: 4-0, #1 seed, 410.5 points for (2nd).
Playoffs 95.5%, #1 seed 44.9% after the trade (95.7% / 45.7% before). We are 2 wins ahead of 8th place today.
Week 5 is the test: Mahomies (2-2) project 113.4 to our 105.9, a 39.5% win chance. A loss likely cuts the cushion over 8th to 1 game, which flips us to WIN NOW.

Bye rivals at 3-1: D'ez Nutz (seed 2), Liddle' Schitty (seed 3), El' Político (seed 4) and Oviedo (seed 5). We play Oviedo Wk 10 and Liddle' Wk 13: full lineup both weeks (head-to-head is the first tiebreaker).

We pick 6th of 14 (ESPN waiver order, Oct 8). The order is rolling, not inverse standings. Only 8 players are on waivers (Kyle Williams, Miller, Schultz, Harrison Jr., Black, Mariota, Henry Jr., Baker Mayfield); they process Fri 3 AM ET.
Both Week 5 moves are free agents, so they are instant adds with no waiver fight: 1) Falcons D/ST, drop Rams D/ST (likely); 2) Kaden Wetjen, drop Ekeler (likely).
Rams D/ST face Buffalo, our own QB Allen: never stream against our own QB. Falcons D/ST project 5.4 vs 2.6, home vs Baltimore Sun 8:20 PM ET, with Lamar Jackson out of Wed practice (ankle).
